notes:
**The page-turn strips at full size.** In Settings > Page turning, a bar along the bottom of the screen now shows the turn strips edge to edge at their real width, so you can see exactly where a tap will turn the page. The – and + buttons change it.

**Clearer headings in Settings.** The headings within each section are larger and bolder, so each group of settings is easy to find.

If you use two tablets together, update both.
